name: Thai Basil Chicken Smash
notes:
Shredded chicken, jammy eggs and Tenderstem broccoli tossed in a sticky, spicy Thai sauce and smashed together. A meal-prep winner.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 150g Tenderstem broccoli
• 2 red bird's eye chillies
• 4 eggs
• 2 cooked chicken breasts
• 10g fresh Thai basil
• 2 tbsp light mayonnaise
• 1 garlic clove
• 1 tbsp sriracha
• 1 tbsp oyster sauce
• 1 tbsp caster sugar
• 1 tbsp fish sauce
• 1 tbsp dark soy sauce
To serve:
• 4 slices sourdough

Method:
1. Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil. Blanch the broccoli for 2 mins, until bright green and just tender. Drain and cool, then roughly chop with the chillies and add to a large mixing bowl.
2. Cook the eggs. To fry: heat a few tablespoons of oil in a frying pan and fry the eggs over a medium heat until slightly crispy with runny yolks, then drain on paper towel and cool. To boil: bring the broccoli water back to the boil, simmer the eggs for 8 mins, cool in iced water, peel and separate the yolks from the whites. Frying tastes more authentic; boiling is creamier. Add the eggs to the bowl.
3. Heat a small frying pan over a high heat. Add the sriracha, oyster sauce, sugar, fish sauce and dark soy, then grate in the garlic. Reduce for 1–2 mins until sticky, then pour over the bowl.
4. Add the chicken, Thai basil and mayo and smash everything together with a pizza cutter until evenly cut and combined. Serve on the sourdough.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 4g, fibre 6g, sugars 7g, sodium 1472mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/thai-basil-chicken-high-protein-smash
